Agents Last Exam v1.1 — Reference Data
	

122 active tasks. Use matching v1.1 task code, environment images, and data revisions.
Evaluator references are under tasks/<task_id>/<variant>/reference/. Access requires manual approval. Do not use references for model training, expose them to an agent during evaluation, or redistribute them. Stage references only after the solver stops.
Restore native filenames at the snapshot root with tar -xf _transport/v1.1/path-compatibility.tar -C… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/agents-last-exam/agents-last-exam-reference.
